content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to PMP® Certification in Manchester

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: PMI requires a combination of formal education and documented project-management experience. Review PMI's specific requirements for your background—typically a bachelor's degree plus years of directed project experience, or an associate degree with additional experience. Gather your project documentation before you apply.

steps_items.heading: Complete 35 Contact Hours of Training
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led PMP® Certification Training course. Attend sessions on your schedule from anywhere, learning directly from active certified practitioners. All 35 required contact hours are delivered interactively, covering the PMBOK® Guide and exam domains.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your formal application to PMI, including your project-experience documentation and course completion certificate from Granite PM Academy. Pay the examination fee through PMI's online portal. PMI reviews and approves your eligibility before you schedule your exam.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Use Granite PM Academy's targeted exam-preparation resources—practice tests, study guides, and review sessions—to strengthen your knowledge. Schedule your computer-based exam at a Pearson VUE testing center. You'll complete the PMP® exam on your own timeline once you're confident and ready.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your PMP® Credential
steps_items.text: PMP® certification is valid for three years. During each renewal cycle, earn Professional Development Units (PDUs) through continuing education, project work, or volunteer activities. Renew by the expiration date to keep your credential active and competitive in Manchester's job market.

fq_items.question: Do I need to travel to {city} for this training?

fq_items.question: What are the PMP eligibility requirements?
fq_items.answer: PMI sets four eligibility paths based on education: a secondary diploma (high school or equivalent) requires 60 months of project leadership experience; an associate's degree requires 48 months; a bachelor's degree requires 36 months; and a bachelor's or postgraduate degree from a PMI Global Accreditation Center (GAC)-accredited program requires just 24 months. Every path also requires 35 hours of project management education — our course satisfies this requirement in full.

fq_items.question: How long does it take to get PMP certified in {city}?
fq_items.answer: After completing training, PMI typically approves applications within 5–10 business days. Once approved, you have one year to sit for the exam. Most students study 4–8 weeks after the course before scheduling their exam.

fq_items.question: What is your pass guarantee?
fq_items.answer: If you complete our course and do not pass the PMP exam within 90 days, we provide additional coaching sessions at no additional cost until you pass.

fq_items.question: Is this training PMI-approved?
fq_items.answer: Yes. Granite PM Academy is a PMI Premier Authorized Training Partner (ATP). Our curriculum is aligned to PMI’s current Examination Content Outline and our contact hours are fully accepted by PMI.
